input.summary: Ported softmax.cu to SYCL 2020 in port/softmax.cpp. Compiles with icpx -fsycl without any dpct headers (no dpct::, DPCT_* or <dpct/...> left). Both kernels are sub-group-size portable: kernel 0 is one work-item per slice; kernel 1 uses one sub-group per slice via sycl::reduce_over_group, with no hardcoded sub-group size (no reqd_sub_group_size, no warp-32 constant), and sub-groups grid-stride over slices. Switched native::exp to sycl::exp for accuracy. Verified against a CPU expf reference (port/ref.cpp, compared by port/cmp.cpp) over 8192x256, 1000x100, 333x1024 and 5x7: max abs diff <= 1.2e-7 for both kernels, under the 1e-6 atol. Not verified: other sub-group sizes on hardware (only the device default was exercised).
